edit.description: the record read's degrade covers the decode alone, so a file that would not open refuses instead
the unreadable-record refusal, beside the garbled-shape degrades already there

summary: A prior-attempt record that stats present and will not open degrades to "no prior attempt" — the false signal the site's own doc says it refuses
acceptance: a record whose file is present and cannot be read refuses at the read, naming the path, so the degrade to no-prior is only ever for a record that was read and found garbled; every garbled-shape arm and `readAll`'s own descent are unchanged
tests: a prior-attempt record present and unreadable refuses rather than reading as no prior attempt
notes: Measured this tick: a directory at the record path stats fine, so `existsLoud` (`src/priorAttempts.ts:373`) passes it, and `readFile` throws EISDIR on every host and for every uid — no mode needed — landing in the catch at `:398` that exists for garbled JSON. Both docs state the opposite: `read`'s (`:367`) and `readAll`'s (`:421`). The degrade resets the repeated-failure count spec/loop.md keeps and hides the record from every `shouldRun`.
